content.rendered:
Parent-Teacher conferences are a great opportunity to connect with your child’s teacher and learn about their progress so far this year as well as areas for growth. Teachers sent home a sign-up on October 13th via email. October 27th and 28th are designated for conferences, with no school either of those days. While we understand families head out of town or are unable to attend for various reasons, please know teachers are not expected to conference at another time. 

If you have questions, please contact your student(s) teacher, or the office at 503-825-5400.
